name: Vast.ai
tagline: GPU cloud marketplace for renting AI compute.
description: Vast.ai is a marketplace for renting GPUs, connecting people who need AI compute with hosts who list spare hardware — from solo owners to Tier-4 data centers. Prices are set by supply and demand, billed per second, and queryable through code. It supports on-demand, interruptible (spot), and reserved instances across tens of thousands of GPUs and dozens of GPU types.
insight: Founded in 2018, it pioneered the GPU-rental marketplace — the 'Airbnb of GPUs' — pooling spare GPUs from independent hosts worldwide.

modelSupport.notes: Raw GPU rental; run any framework, model, or container.

edge: Marketplace pricing: independent hosts compete, so GPUs (incl. H100s) often run well below first-party clouds, with per-second billing from a $5 minimum.
pros: Often the cheapest GPUs via marketplace
